seoTitle: Word Counter - Count Words, Characters & Sentences
metaDescription: Free online Word Counter. Instantly count words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs in your text. Perfect for essays, tweets, and SEO.
intro: Writing an essay with a strict word limit, or optimizing a blog post for SEO? Our free Word Counter provides instant, accurate metrics for words, characters, and sentences.
whatIs: The Word Counter is a text analysis tool. It processes large blocks of text to provide statistical data including total word count, character count (with and without spaces), sentence count, and paragraph count.
howToUse: Paste or type your text directly into the large input box.
The metrics at the top of the screen will update instantly.
Check the detailed breakdown for average word length and reading time.
howItWorks: The tool uses JavaScript Regular Expressions (Regex) to parse the text. It counts words by looking for spaces and punctuation boundaries. It counts sentences by identifying terminal punctuation (periods, exclamation marks) followed by spaces.
workedExample: You type: 'Hello world. How are you?' The tool calculates: 5 Words, 27 Characters (with spaces), 2 Sentences, and an estimated reading time of 2 seconds.
resultInterpretation: The statistics help you perfectly tailor your text length to meet specific publishing guidelines, academic requirements, or social media limits.
useCases: Academia: Ensuring a college essay meets a strict 1,000-word minimum requirement.
SEO & Marketing: Keeping meta descriptions under 160 characters and blog posts over 1,500 words.
Social Media: Making sure a tweet or Instagram caption fits within platform limits.
tipsAndLimitations: Hyphenated words (like 'state-of-the-art') are generally counted as a single word by standard algorithms.
URLs and email addresses are also treated as single words.

faq.question: What counts as a character?
faq.answer: A character is any single letter, number, punctuation mark, or symbol. A space is also technically a character, which is why we provide counts both 'with spaces' and 'without spaces'.

faq.question: How is reading time calculated?
faq.answer: Reading time is estimated based on the average adult reading speed of about 200 to 250 words per minute.

disclaimer: Analysis happens entirely within your browser. We do not save or store your text.
